nodes.label: Frozen Binary DB Path Pattern
nodes.rationale: When running as a frozen binary (PyInstaller), the database is stored next to the executable rather than the working directory so users don't need to manage CWD.

nodes.label: Credential Retry Loop (credentials-absent-at-startup)
nodes.rationale: Parser loop retries every 30s if credentials are missing so the dashboard can be used to configure them without restarting the process.

nodes.label: v1.4 Auto-Discovery Feature
nodes.rationale: Background task periodically searches Telegram for public Russian-language groups using configured keywords. Joins automatically with flood-safe delays (60-300s) to avoid FloodWait bans.

nodes.label: v1.3 Group Search and Join
nodes.rationale: Groups page redesigned into three sections; state.py introduced to share live TelegramClient with dashboard routes without restarting.

nodes.label: v1.2 Keyword Edit and Stats
nodes.rationale: Inline keyword editing and bulk add added. GET /api/stats endpoint added for single-request stat counts.

nodes.label: v1.0 Combined PyInstaller Binary
nodes.rationale: Parser and dashboard unified into one telelistener executable via PyInstaller; API credentials moved to dashboard settings to eliminate .env editing.

nodes.label: Russian Compliance and Proxy Adaptability
nodes.rationale: App must run on Beget VPS in Russia (Federal Law 152-FZ data localization), must handle TSPU/DPI throttling with reconnection logic, and expose SOCKS5/MTProto proxy config without code changes.

nodes.label: XSS Sanitization via html.escape + markdown strip
nodes.rationale: All raw Telegram message text is stripped of markdown characters then html.escape()'d before rendering in the dashboard to prevent XSS.
nodes.norm_label: xss sanitization via html.escape + markdown strip

nodes.label: PyInstaller Frozen Binary Path Resolution
nodes.rationale: dashboard/main.py uses sys._MEIPASS to resolve template paths inside frozen PyInstaller binary; config.py uses sys.executable for DB_PATH to prevent database-not-found errors when launched from different directories.
